$comment: pdok-adapter (ADR-037 register fragment). Adds the addresses schema that PdokConnector::writeThrough() saves lookup and reverse results into (register integriq, schema addresses). Its properties are exactly the keys PdokConnector::normalize() writes; PdokAddressSchemaTest pins that. pdokId identifies a record: the connector looks a pdokId up before it saves and updates the stored object under its uuid, so each PDOK record is stored once. The schema declares no configuration.unique, because openregister's unique check also counts the object being updated and would refuse that refresh. Spec: openspec/specs/pdok-adapter/spec.md, requirement Write-Through to OR Addresses Register.

addresses.title: Address
addresses.summary: A Dutch address fetched from PDOK, kept so the next lookup needs no call
addresses.description: One row per PDOK Locatieserver record that a lookup or reverse geocode returned, in the PostalAddress shape. The row is refreshed when it is older than an hour and asked for again. A field PDOK does not give for a record is stored as null.

pdokId.title: PDOK id
pdokId.description: The Locatieserver id of the record, such as adr-0363200000218908. One stored address per id.

displayName.title: Address
displayName.description: The address as PDOK writes it on one line.

houseNumber.title: House number
houseNumber.description: The house number with its letter, such as 12a.

bagBuildingId.title: BAG building ids
bagBuildingId.description: The BAG pand ids of the buildings the address lies in.

location.title: Location
location.description: The centre point as a GeoJSON Point, longitude first.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the address came from, always pdok.

fetchedAt.title: Fetched at
fetchedAt.description: When the address was last fetched from PDOK.
